name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-01-29, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.13 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
